title: Jaishankar at UNGA highlights AI, says nations should shape own technology paths
description: S Jaishankar addressed the 81st United Nations General Assembly and highlighted the significance of artificial intelligence. He affirmed the right of nations to develop their own AI models aligned with national priorities. Jaishankar emphasized mutual respect in technology access and the need for cultural understanding in a globalized world. He pointed out the challenges faced by the Global South amid crises in food, fuel, and finance.
